ranked.headline: Generative and factorization models target specific failure modes in omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test what single-cell and multi-omics models learn, not only aggregate performance.

ranked.headline: Physical models link mechanical forces to cell state, adhesion, and tissue organization
ranked.summary: Mechanical models now yield testable predictions for EMT junction states, nuclear lamina remodeling, and epithelial stratification.

ranked.headline: Simulation and ML link disordered sequence patterning to binding and ensembles
ranked.summary: Ensemble, binding and design tools for disordered and flexible proteins are now being tested against experimental and structural data.

ranked.headline: Supervised learners predict drug, microbiome and gene outcomes from molecular inputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method extend supervised learners to small-sample omics, knowledge graphs and drug-target prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Accessible software for single-molecule tracking, localisation and membrane cryo-EM
ranked.summary: Usable tools now bundle fitting and statistical interpretation for single-molecule data, extending to cryo-EM membrane and microtubule reconstructions.

ranked.headline: Software tools standardizing cross-platform omics meta-analysis and sequence design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair multi-omics prioritization with web portals that make cross-platform and meta-analytic workflows usable without coding.

ranked.headline: Encoding spatial and modular dependence when inferring structure from biological data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study model host mobility, immune cell neighborhoods, and SNP modules as spatially informative rather than independent.

ranked.headline: k-mer models classify pathogen genomes and sequence differences without alignment
ranked.summary: Alignment-free k-mer and CNN models now operate on partial, low-coverage, and whole-genome pathogen sequence data.

ranked.headline: Protein language and graph models predict peptide bioactivity and receptor binding
ranked.summary: Protein language models and structure-aware graph networks are now applied to peptide design, TCR recognition, and GPCR ligand prediction.

ranked.headline: Community-scale inference from pooled, simulated and heterogeneous omics datasets
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous batches, phylogenetic structure and ground-truth benchmarks are now being built into single probabilistic or generative omics models.

ranked.headline: Computational methods couple tissue imaging with spatial gene expression across scales
ranked.summary: Deep learning and optimal transport methods now align spatial transcriptomics with histology, while imaging-derived morphology is linked to transcriptomic…

ranked.headline: Structural modeling workflows enforce density, energetic, and ensemble constraints
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a peer-reviewed tool target practical fidelity limits in cryo-EM refinement, conformational sampling, and QM/MM timescales.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence models extend functional annotation to unseen enzyme labels and variants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers test whether learned sequence models generalize to unseen labels and to settings with limited annotated data.

ranked.headline: Inference frameworks decode developmental and multi-omic structure in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool extend single-cell inference to barcoded designs, multi-omic integration and multi-species alignment.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for structure inference, benchmarking, and lead prioritization
ranked.summary: Current preprints and papers pair transcriptomic, spectral, and literature-mined evidence with computational prediction and experimental checks.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling resolves tissue-level state beyond cell-type labels
ranked.summary: Human tissue transcriptomics is moving from cell-type labels toward patient-, regulatory-, and geometry-level state, with network context attached to the…

ranked.headline: Computational models link chromatin contacts, nucleosome dynamics and epigenetic states
ranked.summary: Learned and simulation-based models now infer chromatin contacts, nucleosome correlations and chromatin states from binding profiles, epigenetic marks and…

ranked.headline: Refined sequencing methods resolve tRNA structure, modifications, and RBP-RNA binding
ranked.summary: Recent methods resolve tRNA structure and modification sites at single-read resolution and map RBP-RNA interactions at large scale.

ranked.headline: Layered evidence scoring maps protein domains, complexes, and structures across genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply integrated scoring across orthology, domain, and structural evidence to annotate proteomes at scale.

ranked.headline: Fusing pretrained embeddings with engineered or graph inputs for biomolecular prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence and molecular representations are now combined with task-specific encodings and benchmarked against prior models on defined tasks.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models for RNA function, localization, and siRNA efficacy prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained RNA language model embeddings are now being fused with graph and state-space architectures across multiple RNA prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Embedding geometry and interpretability readouts in biological foundation models
ranked.summary: Interpretability readouts and embedding geometry of biological foundation models are now validated against known biology across single-cell and bulk data.

ranked.headline: Synaptic structure constrains neural decoding and efficient coding in spiking models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie synaptic tuning, sign constraints, and conductance to population readout limits and energy-efficient synaptic operating points.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations link membrane, capsid, and nuclear pore mechanics
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and nanoindentation simulations now probe membrane, viral capsid, and nuclear pore behavior as computational predictions.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks infer gene regulation from bulk, single-cell and lineage data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair population-scale simulation, lineage barcodes, and multimodal benchmarks with regulator inference to test single-cell methods.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and active-learning strategies refine structure-based ligand prioritization
ranked.summary: GPU-accelerated unified screening and simulated design cycles with uncertainty-based active learning now address prioritization under assay proxies.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and multimodal cell models are being tested on single-cell tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published benchmark now evaluate LLM agents and multimodal cell models on single-cell tasks.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and long-read tools validated for rDNA, ITS, and taxonomic assignment
ranked.summary: Long-read and mixed-sample sequencing data require pipelines whose accuracy is evaluated against simulated or defined reference datasets.

ranked.headline: Genomic analyses increasingly move beyond a single linear reference coordinate system
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved assemblies, pangenome paths, and genome-wide repeats increasingly supplement single linear coordinates for core genomic inference.

ranked.headline: Spectrum-centric computational tools for proteoform and peptide identification
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release large top-down spectral resources, low-input DIA benchmarks, and modular immunopeptidogenomic pipelines.

ranked.headline: Sequence and chromatin context guide DNA methylation and regulatory annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend DNA methylation profiling and CpG conservation analyses toward tumor biomarkers, ageing and CRISPR epigenome editing.

ranked.headline: Long-read pangenomes link structural and transposable element variants to traits
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies and graph pangenomes now resolve large inversions and transposable element variants tied to traits and climate.

ranked.headline: Validating predicted conformational ensembles against experimental structural data
ranked.summary: AlphaFold3, ML potentials, and FRET-guided selection are now being checked against experimental structures, energetics, and transfer efficiencies.

ranked.headline: Learned models coupled to genetic association testing link genotypes to phenotypes
ranked.summary: Deep models and multivariate GWAS now support locus- and liability-level genetic inference from genotypes and paired MRIs.

ranked.headline: HLA-aware viral simulation, accelerated read simulation and automated selection analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend sequence simulation and selection workflows with HLA-aware CTL modeling, SIMD-parallel read generation and HyPhy automation.

ranked.headline: Minimal closed-form models capture adaptation, morphogenesis and flight dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints derive analytical timescales and interpretable modes from minimal closed-loop or data-driven formulations spanning several scales.

ranked.headline: Network and probabilistic models infer signaling and proteolysis from proteomic data
ranked.summary: Recent proteomics studies extend network inference to time-resolved interaction changes, proteolytic flow recovery, and kinase pathway benchmarking.
